title: Love And Other Disasters
notes: | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Effects that activate when creatures are afflicted with a buff or debuff are ignored". Fix: H: bc_OnBuffDebuff L33-L36: exit for every buff/debuff (any source, including none). vs bugged: mixed. USER DECISION: reverses the earlier 'one-sided by design' (CROSS) reading; the global version also cancels the holder's own side's effects User 2026-10-26: global, as the text reads (no prior design ruling by the user). Fix = extend the trait's existing side test to the bearer's side too; no other changes (e.g. Life And Other Illusions: no extra handling of defenders' when-attacked effects). 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Love And Other Disasters on your creature; give your creature a buff that has an 'after gaining a buff' trait reaction (e.g. a trait that reacts to buffs): the reaction should not fire.

release_notes.intended: Effects that activate when creatures gain a buff or debuff are ignored.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only the effects of the side opposing the holder were ignored.
release_notes.fix: Now these effects are ignored for both sides, whichever side holds the trait.
